title: Cap Reached for Additional Returning Worker H-2B Visas for the Early Second Half of FY 2025
paragraphs: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services has received enough petitions to reach the cap for the additional 19,000 H-2B visas made available for returning workers for the early second half of fiscal year (FY) 2025 with start dates from April 1 to May 14, 2025, underthe H-2B supplemental cap temporary final rule (FY 2025 TFR). April 18, 2025, was the final receipt date for petitions requesting supplemental H-2B visas under the FY 2025 early second half returning worker allocation.
Additional information on the FY 2025 supplemental visas is available on theTemporary Increase in H-2B Nonimmigrant Visas for FY 2025page.
